jgit-storage-hibernate performance

Last update: Repository:

Reading rule for every chart: lower lines and points are better/faster; higher lines and points are worse/slower or more expensive. Timing and throughput are normalized to ms/op. Non-time evidence is published only with the same smaller-is-better direction.

Each chart groups one stable operation and one physical unit. Patterns, markers and the latest-value table expose overlapping measurements. The ¶ beside a chart title is a stable direct link.
Library-impact relevance

All filters are selected by default. They hide or show existing charts only; measured values are never recomputed. Consumer tags mean the pinned compatibility contract uses the required library modules, not that the benchmark measured that application.
